title: Expondo — Blackout Sale
desc: Black Week became a solar eclipse

blocks.title: Expondo — Blackout Sale
blocks.lede: Black Week became a solar eclipse.

items.label: Role
items.value: Creative direction, campaign concept, art direction, landing page

items.label: Scope
items.value: Campaign concept, motion, landing page, email, channel adaptations

items.statement: Black Week had a noise problem.
body: Black backgrounds. Red accents. Giant discounts. Increasingly desperate typography.
The category had spent so long trying to look urgent that urgency itself had become invisible.
Instead of making Expondo shout louder, I wanted to make people notice the moment something went quiet.
A solar eclipse gave the campaign a built-in narrative: the light disappears slowly, everything goes dark, then the sale is revealed.

items.title: The light disappears slowly
items.body: The category shouts; the campaign begins by dimming. Everyday scenes lose their light one notch at a time.

items.title: Everything goes dark
items.body: Full eclipse. Darkness, atmospheric light, and the feeling that light itself is becoming scarce.

items.title: The sale is revealed
items.body: The light returns as the offer. One event across motion, landing pages and email — not a pile of channel adaptations.

blocks.text: The drama was already in the idea. We didn’t need to invent it.

body: A full visual world built around darkness, atmospheric light and the feeling that light itself was becoming scarce.
Motion, landing pages and email followed the same three-stage structure, so the campaign felt like one event rather than a pile of channel adaptations.
The campaign became one of Expondo’s key creative drivers for Black Week and was associated with a noticeably improved sales period.
